note: Starting points a creator can open in the builder and then change completely. Each entry is a .moonpad.json — exactly what Save project writes.

templates.name: Chain Punks
templates.blurb: The classic 24x24 head-and-shoulders — mohawks, smokes, an earring, and two rare skins. Original pixels, familiar attitude.

templates.name: Crypto Rats
templates.blurb: Beady eyes, big ears, whiskers, and the odd gold chain. Scrappy on purpose.

templates.name: Monkey Business
templates.blurb: Round ears, a lighter muzzle, plenty of attitude. Wide-eyed or unimpressed — your call.

templates.name: Alley Cats
templates.blurb: Slit pupils, flared cheeks, proper triangular ears. The easiest set to recolour into your own.

templates.name: Moonettes
templates.blurb: Pixel chibi — big shiny eyes, blush, bows and buns on pastel grounds. Sweet where the punks are sour.

templates.name: Moon Frogs
templates.blurb: Wide grins, eye bumps, a belly patch and the odd golden rare. The pond’s answer to the punks.

templates.name: Lunar Drift
templates.blurb: Raster, not pixel: gradient skies, glowing moons, auroras and a noise-drawn horizon. Landscapes, no characters.

templates.name: Night Blooms
templates.blurb: Procedural flowers — petal counts, colourways and glowing cores on deep grounds. Organic, and nothing like the portraits.

templates.name: Orbitals
templates.blurb: Generative ring systems — a glowing core, tilted orbits, comets mid-flight. The abstract one.

templates.name: Moon Spirits
templates.blurb: Soft glowing ghosts — smooth domes, wavy hems, glossy eyes, a halo or a sprout. The raster character set.
